map.CAT 与 mMRC 区别？: What is the difference between CAT and mMRC?
map.CAT 全面评估症状/活动/心理，mMRC 仅呼吸困难；二者互补。: CAT evaluates symptoms, activity and psychology comprehensively, while mMRC covers only breathlessness; the two complement each other.
map.COPD CAT 评估问卷器 使用指南: COPD CAT Questionnaire Tool User Guide
map.→ 打开COPD CAT 评估问卷器工具: -> Open the COPD CAT questionnaire tool
map.多少分需随访？: At what score is follow-up needed?
map.慢性阻塞性肺疾病评估测试(CAT)，8项0–5分，总分0–40，评估COPD对患: The COPD Assessment Test (CAT) has 8 items scored 0-5 for a total of 0-40, assessing the impact of COPD on the patient's health status
map.每 3 月复评，变化≥2 分有临床意义。: Reassess every 3 months; a change of >=2 points is clinically meaningful.
map.胸水 Light 标准渗出/漏出鉴别器: Pleural Effusion Light Criteria Exudate/Transudate Differentiator
map.：总分=8×2=16 分：10–20 为中度影响，建议含长效支扩剂治疗。: : total score = 8x2 = 16 points: 10-20 is a moderate impact, so a long-acting bronchodilator is recommended.
map.：总分≥20：症状重度，考虑 LAMA+LABA 或联合 ICS。: : total score >=20: severe symptoms, consider LAMA+LABA or combination with ICS.
